item.title: [汽车] NHTSA推OTA召回现代化：电子通知与AV
item.author: @SawyerMerritt
item.description:
NHTSA启动车辆安全召回现代化计划，重点推进OTA软件修复；承认OTA完成率高，拟允许电子通知替代邮寄，并向各州拨款150万美元改进召回通知，同时审视自动驾驶与软件修复适用规则。

@SawyerMerritt · 赞 319 · 转 27 · 浏览 27126

NHTSA is launching a new initiative to modernize vehicle safety recalls, with a major focus on over-the-air (OTA) software updates. Info: • NHTSA acknowledges that OTA recall fixes generally achieve high completion rates because owners don't need to visit a dealership/service center. • The agency is exploring more flexible recall notification requirements, including electronic notifications instead of traditional mail (I've been asking for this!) • NHTSA announced $1.5 million in grants to help states improve how vehicle owners are notified about outstanding recalls. • NHTSA is examining how recall requirements apply to autonomous vehicles and software-based fixes.
